body: Mitosis run 2026-09-24-android-fixes (plan 277a22ea5130) progress at 22:18 MDT: Lanes 2 (video-playback), 10 (notes-and-cards), 17 (garden) and 25 (settings-screen) finished with worker status ok and green suites, but every Lane commit failed with exit 128 because commit.gpgsign=true with gpg.format ssh and the ssh-agent holds no identities (the id_ed25519 key has a passphrase). Recovery: owner loads the key with ssh-add (Claude never enters the passphrase); after the run ends, flip the commit-failed Lanes to state held in state.json so --resume lands them without re-dispatching (run.py checks the write-set is still dirty via _still_written).
